title: Integral lisse-lattice realization in the common-stage coefficient category
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme. Use the coefficient extensions [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], completed coefficient modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. An object $K$ of the latter category has an integral lisse-lattice realization if there exist a finite coefficient stage $E\subset\Omega$, an integral constructible object $M$, and a finite locally free module $N$ over the completed $\mathcal O_E$ coefficient sheaf, such that $M\cong N[0]$ in the completed integral derived category and $K$ is isomorphic to the image of $M$ under rationalization and common-stage inclusion. Finite locally free allows zero and varying finite local ranks. This is the completed-coefficient presentation of an integral lattice in a lisse adic sheaf [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]; it does not require that the lattice be preserved by an additional Weil structure.
